propositions: rebar transition has two distinct --force flags with different meanings (start-work gate and close gate) while rebar claim uses a single --force spelling, causing inconsistency and operator confusion
renaming --force-close to --force on the transition close path collapses two force flags into one --force[=<reason>] whose meaning is dispatched by target status

the hand-rolled _parse_flags loop silently skips unknown tokens, so a simple deletion would make stale --force-close invocations silently bypass the gate they meant to; an explicit rejection branch raising CommandError prevents this outcome

scripts/dependency_audit.py concurrently landed after the rename and still emitted the retired --force-close flag, requiring a follow-up fix and a regression test that feeds generated argv to the real parser
